event: FC Expo 2024 — First Circle Business Expo, 'Udyami Vokkaliga'
identityConfidence: HIGH for the event and organiser. FC Expo is the Udyami Vokkaliga Business & Entrepreneurship Expo run by First Circle Society / First Circle Biztech Pvt Ltd, a Bengaluru business-networking body for the Vokkaliga community. The 2024 edition was inaugurated by the Chief Minister of Karnataka together with Vokkaliga ministers from the Union and State cabinets. Venue not yet confirmed.
